changes: Installs over USB on the Modwerk beta base beside POLY8 and other modules that change playback speed. The sound is unchanged.
Needs a Modwerk base with module events; older bases refuse this version and keep 0.1.2-experimental.

Add RPCH to track TSTR and REPITCH to sample attributes. PTCH is disabled while RATE still applies; Pickup machines are unsupported.
